title: bomarea crocea
intro: Bomarea crocea, commonly known as the yellow globeflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Alstroemeriaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic and antiseptic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for pain relief and wound care. Bioactive constituents of Bomarea crocea include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
